Q: Language conversion issue in generate pdf in flutter A:

1. Use a Devanagari font that supports Marathi
https://fonts.google.com/noto#sans-deva
Make sure your TTF font is copied to assets and declared in pubspec.yaml.Use pw.Font.ttf() not the default font.
2. For full Devanagari support (ligatures, complex characters)

The pdf package alone cannot handle ligatures fully. You need to pre-shape the text using harfbuzz or flutter_text_shaper, or better:

  • Use printing package with pdf package

  • Use Google Fonts Noto Sans Devanagari

  • Sometimes using pw.RichText with correct font helps.

Q: npm check and update package if needed A:

If you want to upgrade a package to the latest release (major, minor and patch), append the @latest keyword to the end of the package name, for example:

npm i express-mongo-sanitize@latest

This will update express-mongo-sanitize from version 1.2.1 for example to version 2.2.0.

If you want to know which packages are outdated and which can be updated, use the npm outdated command

Example:

npm outdated

Output:

Package             Current   Wanted  Latest  Location                         Depended by

request-ip            2.2.0    2.2.0   3.3.0  node_modules/request-ip          apiv2
